stops.name: Parque natural del Tajo Internacional
stops.detail: The Natural Park of Tagus International (in Portuguese Natural Park do Tejo International, PNTI) is the name used to designate two natural spaces protected with identical characteristics but with different management. One in the province of Cáceres, an autonomous community of Extremadura, Spain and another in Castelo Branco District, Central Region, Portugal.)
